named_subject: giraffe head and neck in profile, facing right
action: The giraffe head stays facing right while it shifts down and shrinks in frames 3 to 6, then grows back and rises in frames 7 and 8, with no visible mouth or chewing motion.
identity_gap: The head construction matches the doodle (two ossicones with one drawn as a P-shaped flag, small open ear, arrow eye, muzzle hook, jaw loop), but the long neck with its crossing strokes is cut off by the frame bottom and the lines are thinner than the doodle's heavy strokes.
notes: The film shows a nearly fixed head that chews and opens its mouth in frames 3 and 7, while the animation instead changes scale and position in jumps and keeps the mouth closed. Holding the head scale steady and animating the jaw and muzzle line to match the chewing would help most.
